name: Question 1
worked_solution:
First, we get the minor corresponding to ${c}_{21}$, removing the $2$nd row and the $1$st column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 2 & 1 & -2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{21}=|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${c}_{21}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{21} & =(-1)^{2+1}{M}_{21} \\  & =-{M}_{21} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 1
?

Find the cofactor of c21 in C=[−22301305021−2−7003].

a
|10501−2−703|
b
|−22002−2−703|
c
−|23021−2003|
d
|23021−2003|
e
−|−22013502−2|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we get the minor corresponding to c21, removing the 2nd row and the 1st column:

C=[∗2301∗∗∗∗21−2∗003]

So, the minor is

M21=|23021−2003|.

Therefore, the cofactor of c21 is

C21=(−1)2+1M21=−M21=−|23021−2003|.
